# Introduction {#sec-introduction}

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

Part 1 provides relevant context to help understand what motivates the book.

## Chapters

In this part of the book, there are four chapters, which cover the following topics.

- The unrealised potential of psychology and neuroscience research (@sec-mind-brain).
- A brief history of verification in science (@sec-history).
- What the endpoint of a research project might look like (@sec-done).
- Domain-general software tools that provide a foundational infrastructure for science (@sec-infrastructure).

:::
